import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys
l=Path.cwd()
for n in ['tensor','chordal','weak-public']:
 t=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(l/f'sources/{n}.pdf'),'-'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout
 subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(l/'write_lane.py'),f'sources/{n}.txt'],input=t,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
 print('BODY',n,len(t));print(t if n!='weak-public' else t[:21000])
